== Acquisition ==
This skill is given to Warriors competing in a [[Dwayna Vs Grenth]] match, as well as in repeatable [[Wintersday]] quests.

== Related skills ==
* {{skill icon|"Charge!"}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|"Fall Back!"}}
* {{skill icon|"Incoming!"}}  (elite)
* {{skill icon|"Make Your Time!"}}

== Notes ==
* This skill is only available to players during [[Wintersday]] events.
* This skill increases average speed by 1.67% if used every time it recharges.
* [[Miniature]]s that are in range will give you one extra strike of adrenaline when this skill is used.
